The name Neill is derived from the Latin name Neilos, which translates to 'cloud'. In Greek mythology, Neill is the name of a river god, symbolizing the power and protection of the natural world. In Christian context, the name Neill may evoke a sense of divine intervention and guidance, like a cloud shielding people from harm. The name has gained popularity in the Christian community due to its rich history and symbolism.
